calculation.description: Contrarian signal to the acceleration of each asset's 20-session trend relative to its one-third 60-session trend, normalized by 30-session realized volatility and lagged one completed session. Positive values favor recent under-accelerators.

validation.regime_notes: Daily reversal direction passes the benchmark absolute IC gate and annualized ICIR gate. By regime, daily IC was -0.005255 in 2020-2022, +0.018215 in 2023-2025, +0.003030 in 2026-2027, and +0.018594 in 2028-2030. Five-day and ten-day ICs were negative after sign reversal (-0.016779 and -0.037505), so use as a small daily reversal sleeve rather than a medium-horizon trend factor.
